description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and rights of way. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights in the Kohuwala area, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
